    Descent of shift-compatible functors through shift-orbit categories #

    A functor commuting coherently with shifts acts on homogeneous shifted morphisms and hence on their finite-support direct sums. If its target has the trivial shift, summing the target degree components gives a descended functor from the source shift-orbit category. The final section applies this construction to Gabriel orbit push-down.
